geminiApiKey.label: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.helpText: From https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Used for query normalization, reranking, answer generation and learning from comment threads.

dryRun.label: Dry run
dryRun.helpText: Log the reply the bot would post without posting it. Leave this ON until you have read a few runs.

questionFlairsOnly.label: Question flairs only
questionFlairsOnly.helpText: On: only posts flaired Ask, Question, Admissions or Doubt are considered. Off: every post is considered, and the bot still replies only when the knowledge base answers it confidently.

minConfidence.label: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.helpText: Reranked top score a post must clear before the bot replies. Raise this if it is too chatty.

maxPostAgeMinutes.label: Max post age (minutes)
maxPostAgeMinutes.helpText: Never touch anything older than this.
